summary: Phase 12 (P1): backend modularization, DB indexes, and LLM resilience. Refactored the monolithic backend/server.py (~1000 lines) into config/deps/utils + db/ (migrations, indexes) + models/ + services/ (llm, events, memory, listing, vision, marketing_agent, integrations) + routes/ (one module per domain) with ZERO behavior change. Route parity verified: 33/33 identical paths and methods. Fixed the WORKSPACE_CREATED event bug (create_workspace previously logged ITEM_CREATED). Added the recommended MongoDB index set applied on startup. Added LLM retry with exponential backoff and response caching (vision never cached). Legacy test scripts relocated to backend/tests/ with skip guards; new fully-local test suites run against an in-memory Mongo (mongomock) with a mocked LLM. Full local suite: 40 passed, 2 skipped (LLM POCs that require a real key). Uvicorn HTTP smoke test passed (workspace creation, item CRUD scoping, integrations seeding, inbox refresh, export, event stream).
